findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素：FTC 與 DOJ 近年積極挑戰併購，持續積極執法會增加收購的時間與費用並可能降低成交可能性（對併購／新設醫院的一般性風險，非針對 EHC 的調查）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In recent years, the Federal Trade Commission and DOJ have been aggressive in challenging mergers and acquisitions they believe present antitrust concerns and in asserting novel legal arguments for what constitutes unlawful anticompetitive activity.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 法律程序：公司處於高度監管產業，受政府稽核與調查，並可能有未揭露的 qui tam（FCA）訴訟；未列出反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: In the ordinary course of our business, we are subject to regulatory and other governmental audits and investigations and are party to various legal actions, proceedings, and claims, including wage and hour, employment and personal injury claims, some of which seek to be certified as class or collective actions.

findings.claim: CMS FY2027 IRF 最終支付規則（2026-07-30）：EHC 估計每名 Medicare 出院淨營收約 +2.3%，自 2026-10-01 起。
findings.source: MarketBeat Encompass Health Q2 earnings call highlights

note: 搜尋未見針對 EHC 的 DOJ/FTC/EU 反壟斷調查或拆分報導；僅見律所證券調查徵求（與 2025-07 媒體報導相關）與 CMS FY2027 IRF 支付規則等一般監管，搜尋摘要無可逐字引用原文，故未列入 findings。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
